label: My return: one capital-gains sale

params.name: asset
params.label: the kind of asset (chip myreturn.cg_rules assets)

params.name: term
params.label: long / short, typed when the dates are not known

params.name: cost
params.label: cost of acquisition (FMV on 1 April 2001 for an asset bought before)

params.name: expenses
params.label: expenses wholly on the transfer (brokerage, stamp duty paid by the seller)

params.name: stamp
params.label: s.50C: the stamp-duty value of land / building

description_nl: 2026-10-07: One transfer of a capital asset (s.45 / s.48): short- or long-term by the months it was held (more than 12 / 24 months is long), s.50AA (always short-term), the bucket it is taxed in (111A 20%, 112A 12.5% over 1.25 lakh, 112 12.5%, or the slab rates), s.50C for land / building (the stamp-duty value when it is more than 110% of the price), 112A grandfathering for shares bought before 1 February 2018, and for land / building bought before 23 July 2024 by a resident the gain with indexation too (cost x CII of the year of sale / CII of the year bought).
